operations.name: Tamako Matano

expected.name: Tamako Matano
expected.description: Tamako Matano was a teacher at Waianae Hongwanji Japanese Language School and the wife of detained Buddhist priest Konin Matano. Her individual JCCH record documents March 1945 departure from Hawaii to join confined family, Sharp Park detention March 1945, Crystal City confinement March-December 1945 and return to Honolulu aboard Shawnee December 1945. Her entry into family confinement is distinct from her husband’s December 1941 arrest. No individual criminal conviction is established by the archive. Source: https://incarceration.jcchawaii.org/internees/matano-tamako

operations.research_note: Honolulu Advertiser obituary of March7,1991, transcribed in BYU Hawaii obituary archive, records death March4,1991 aged88. Identity corroborated by children Albert, Bernard, Cherry, Florence, Alice and Caroline matching JCCH household of Konin and Tamako Matano. Added exact death date only. December7,1902 birth date appears in SSDI mirrors but remains unrefined pending stronger original evidence. Biography and custody dates preserved.
